title: Evaluation Reporting & Telemetry
summary: This module provides utilities for collecting OpenTelemetry spans for tracing and functions for rendering numerical differences and durations in evaluation reports. It supports detailed comparison and formatting of performance metrics.

nodes.label: Collect OpenTelemetry Spans
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Span Context
nodes.description: Provides a context manager to collect all OpenTelemetry spans generated within its scope, yielding a SpanTree for analysis or a recording error if no provider is configured.

nodes.label: Render Number Differences
nodes.title: Number Difference Renderer
nodes.description: Formats the difference between two numerical values (integers or floats) into a human-readable string, including absolute and relative changes with appropriate precision.

nodes.label: Render Duration Differences
nodes.title: Duration Difference Renderer
nodes.description: Formats the difference between two durations (in seconds) into a human-readable string, showing both absolute and relative changes.

nodes.label: Render Single Duration
nodes.title: Duration Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a given duration in seconds into a human-readable string, adjusting units (microseconds, milliseconds, seconds) based on magnitude.

groups.label: Telemetry Collection
groups.title: OpenTelemetry Span Collection
groups.description: Manages the collection of OpenTelemetry spans for tracing and performance analysis within a defined execution context.

groups.label: Reporting Utilities
groups.title: Numerical and Duration Reporting
groups.description: Provides functions for formatting and rendering numerical and temporal differences, as well as single durations, for evaluation reports.
